conditions: The processor claims XQuery 3.1 conformance. Application of the two requirement branches depends on whether it supplies the Serialization Feature.
limitations: A vendor-defined output serialization or access to un-serialized XDM values is a distinct possibility. The claim does not guarantee successful serialization through every implementation or invocation.

triggers: W3C source correction or erratum, spec byte drift, or material contrary scoped evidence.

statement: An XQuery 3.1 processor providing the Serialization Feature must meet §2.2.4. A processor without the feature must not reject an output declaration merely because it lacks that feature and must implement fn:serialize, whose invocation may raise an error as specified.
